# NEW 2026-11-17 conquest campaigns (phase 1 + 2). Generated by gen_heg_campaigns.py; edit the generator, not this file.
on_location_occupied = { on_actions = { oe_hc_capture_hook } }
on_siege_won = { on_actions = { oe_hc_capture_hook } }
oe_hc_capture_hook = {
    trigger = { current_year >= 1200 }
    effect = {
        scope:target = {
            oe_hc_egypt_capture = yes
            oe_hc_africa_capture = yes
            oe_hc_italy_capture = yes
            oe_hc_france_capture = yes
            oe_hc_iberia_capture = yes
            oe_hc_britain_capture = yes
            oe_hc_persia_capture = yes
            oe_hc_blacksea_capture = yes
            oe_hc_arabia_capture = yes
        }
    }
}
monthly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_hc_monthly_pulse } }
oe_hc_monthly_pulse = {
    trigger = { current_year >= 1200 tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no has_global_variable = oe_hc_any_active }
    effect = {
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_active } oe_hc_egypt_monthly = yes }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_africa_active } oe_hc_africa_monthly = yes }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_italy_active } oe_hc_italy_monthly = yes }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_france_active } oe_hc_france_monthly = yes }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_iberia_active } oe_hc_iberia_monthly = yes }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_britain_active } oe_hc_britain_monthly = yes }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_persia_active } oe_hc_persia_monthly = yes }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_blacksea_active } oe_hc_blacksea_monthly = yes }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_arabia_active } oe_hc_arabia_monthly = yes }
    }
}
yearly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_hc_ai_pulse } }
oe_hc_ai_pulse = {
    trigger = { current_year >= 1200 tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no is_ai = yes }
    effect = { oe_hc_ai_yearly = yes }
}
